purpose: Read-only preflight of official detection split XML coordinates and merge compatibility for prepare_autodl_voc.py

execution.host: local Windows workspace, not AutoDL or the original training server
execution.transport: Python urllib.request HTTPS HEAD and bounded HTTP Range GET
execution.parser: Python standard-library struct, zipfile, zlib and xml.etree.ElementTree
execution.range_response_required: HTTP 206 with exact requested byte length

sources.name: VOCtrainval_11-May-2012.zip
sources.extra_xml_policy: The archive has 17125 XML members; only the 11540 ImageSets/Main/trainval.txt IDs define the official detection trainval split. Other XML members were excluded from this coordinate audit.

merge_checks.comparison: Exact full ZIP member path intersection for non-directory files; conflicting shared paths compared by central-directory CRC and uncompressed size

coordinate_check.xml_values: Original VOC one-based inclusive xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax
coordinate_check.accepted_predicate: Each coordinate is finite and integer; 1 <= xmin <= xmax <= XML width; 1 <= ymin <= ymax <= XML height
coordinate_check.training_conversion: Zero-based half-open XYXY = [xmin-1, ymin-1, xmax, ymax]
coordinate_check.policy_conclusion: No observed coordinate or filename blocker in the selected official detection splits. Keep strict validation and preserve XML; do not silently clip or rewrite historical labels.

notes: This is a remote ZIP-directory/XML metadata audit, not an executed full dataset preparation or image-integrity check.
Only selected detection XML and split member CRC/size were checked; no complete ZIP SHA256 is claimed.
ZIP sizes are observed HEAD metadata, not cryptographic release identity. The full preparation must record actual archive SHA256 values.
The preparation script must still decode every selected JPEG and compare its dimensions with the original XML before writing complete.json.
Suffix Range requests initially returned HTTP 501 from the local network path; exact positive-offset requests returned HTTP 206 and were used for this audit.
